angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 753,443 km at 342.29 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.9215 +/- 0.0151 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 342.29 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.083 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020PASP..132a4401M/abstract): 753,443 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.993 +/- 0.067 solar masses from Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020PASP..132a4401M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6150 +/- 140 K from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of WASP-28 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of WASP-28 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-28.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.366, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-28 (pscomppars): spectral type F8, from Anderson et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..61A/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WASP-28: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-28 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.2 dex, from Petrucci et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015MNRAS.446.1389P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-28 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.15, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-28 (pscomppars): age 5.5 Gyr, from Močnik et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020PASP..132a4401M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-28 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.25 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
